description: One market's taker fills of 100 USD or more, newest first, from 0xinsider's own record of the exchange's on-chain fills: each fill once, keyed by its transaction hash and log index, with side BUY or SELL for the taker. Walk a window with from and to and page with next_cursor. Fills under 100 USD are not stored. coverage.recorded_from is where the record starts, the later of when recording began and 00:00 UTC on the day 365 days back, so an empty window before it means outside the record, not no trading; coverage.complete_through is how far the record is complete, a few minutes behind now, and a first page serves no fill after it. For large trades with grades and review scores, use get_large_trades_history with condition_id. An unknown market answers not_found.

condition_id.description: Raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; it is bound to the same market, from and to

from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on traded_at; omitted, the walk runs to the start of the record

to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on traded_at; a first page ends at the earlier of to and coverage.complete_through

name: get_market_trades
title: List a market's trades
